Write the whole-module specification

Read input: xout8_combined.v · Open raw
module xout8(clk, rst, ctrl, sel, d, q);
	input			clk;		
	input			rst;		
	input	[15:0]	ctrl;		
	input			sel;		
	inout	[7:0]	d;			
	output	[7:0]	q;			

	tri		[7:0]	d;
	reg		[7:0]	q;

	wire [4:0]	addr;
	wire		ud_t, ld_t, ud_ce, ld_ce;

	// Logic for ctrl_dec
	assign ud_t = (ctrl[0] & sel);
	assign ld_t = (ctrl[1] & sel);
	assign ud_ce = (ctrl[2] & sel);
	assign ld_ce = (ctrl[3] & sel);
	assign addr = ctrl[15:11];

	always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
		if (rst)
			q <= 0;
		else if (ld_ce)
			q <= d;
	end
endmodule
